## Chapter Nine

Downtown



The third week into his stay in the Rehab unit started with a commotion at the desk as three guards entered quickly and under protest from the therapist opened Lucas’s cell. “We have orders to transfer him” the lead guard said, as the guard on his left held the irate therapist back, all the while the man was threatening to report the guards and take his complaint all the way to the top. Lucas looked on as his cell door opened. Any doubt he had on whether the crazy old fool was telling the truth had just been put to bed. Closing his eyes, he slowed his breathing and presented as non-threatening a posture as possible.



Two guards entered his cell and braced Lucas pulling him to his feet and putting on shackles on both his ankles and wrists. They began herding him into the lobby of the Rehab unit. At the sight of him the Therapists Protests picked up a notch as he pushed against the guard, yelling about filing complaints, again the lead guard ignored him. Lucas smiled thinking that the person he would go to, probably was the same one who ordered Lucas taken.



They escorted him out of the unit and he was quickly walked, though if you could call shuffling with uncomfortable shackles on walking, down the hall and out of medical, but instead of turning towards the stairs that would have taken him back to his old tier, the guards pushed him down a new hallway, one that Lucas hadn’t traveled, he thought he knew where they were going and did not look forward to be greeted by his new community.



They walked through three security checkpoints, Lucas was impressed with the foot thick armored doors on magnetic locks as well as the liberal use of cameras and drones as they made there way deeper into the facility. Crossing another checkpoint, Lucas could see it used a redundant biometric scan that required two guards as well as a third guard confirmed that the two using it , were in fact employees. This was the toughest security Lucas had seen in this facility and and he guessed they were getting close to Downtown.



They walked down the last hallway and it opened into a large common area, with two tiers of metal catwalks lined with fifty cells if his quick count was correct. The guards were not gently and pushed Lucas along causing him to wince a little as the shackles pinched. “Easy guys, you’re the ones who put on the speed limiters here” Lucas said feeling the sharp pain as the guard In the rear lightly slapped his head with his stun stick, well at least its not on he thought, deciding to just keep quiet and observe. The lower center area had a few couches, a Holo-screen as well as tables and chairs like in the cafeteria. Convicts roamed the area, looking over the different sections of the lower tier Lucas clocked a workout room among the few that were accessible by the inmates. The group came out on along the top catwalk and he clumsily made his way down a set of steps as the guards continued to hurry him. He was walked about halfway along the lower metal walkway to an open cell and Lucas came face to face with a monster of a man, his ebony skin glistened in the halogen lights as he towered over Lucas outweighing him by at least a hundred points. The man looked Lucas over with an air of distain as he raised his hands and moved at the guard’s encouragement. Once in the cell the guards removed the shackles, all the while laughing among themselves. The guard removing his shackles leaned in and whispered to Lucas before leaving.



“I have fifty credits on you not lasting the night pretty boy, don’t let me down” he said pushing Lucas towards the bunk beds and removing himself from the cell. As the last one was leaving, Lucas turned to see the guard hand his cell mate something “Okay Polar Bear, you two have fun now” he said turning a malicious grin on Lucas before removing himself. Okay Lucas thought, at least he now knew his cell mates name. He would try to play this friendly and see if he could not start the day trying to get killed, but from the exchange between Polar Bear and the guard, he didn’t think It looked good.



Polar Bear turned and grinned at Lucas, the object the guard had handed him hidden in his hand as the big guy stepped closer to him. Lucas left his body relaxed, a smile spreading across his face while he could feel the sweat sliding down his spine, this guy is massive he thought, as he surveyed the room for anything, he could use to defend himself.



He is going to kill me, trying to remember if he actually saw what the guard had given him. Polar Bear was within a step of him when Lucas reacted, he placing his foot on the bottom bunch and grabbing ahold of the rail on the top one, he swung his feet in to the air his right foot landing on Polar Bears left shoulder , turning the foot he slapped his right foot into the big guys throat causing him to make choking sounds.



Unlike the last time, not hard enough to crush his windpipe, Polar Bear tried to back up, tried to move himself away from Lucas but he continued to hold him pressing the foot against his windpipe a little tighter. “Now we are going to have a quick conversation, it’s going to be civil and no one is going to get hurt, do you understand” Lucas asked the big man, forcing his tone to be jovial.



The behemoth stopped moving and stood for a moment before nodding. Lucas debated leaving him at his mercy, but if he was going to share a cell with this guy then he needed to try to reach him. Slowly he removed his feet and put them back on the ground, taking a step back he looked the big guy over, as he stood there rubbing his throat, not angry but almost like a chastised child. He looked guilty. “What’s your story big guy?” Lucas asked his muscles were tight, he didn’t think Polar Bear would come at him again, but he wasn’t about to stake his life on it. The big guy slumped down against the wall and signed, rubbing his neck. “Three time looser, this is my third and final trip, I’ll be in for life, This time it was murder of a federal officer, guy was shaking down my family looking for credits thinking we were some big time dealers, but really, we didn’t have nothing, when he didn’t have the goods, he wanted to take it out in trade, with my sister” the big guy said , Lucas could hear the anger and bitterness in his voice and he thought he got the picture. “So, you were defending your sister?” he asked. Polar Bear just nodded, never making eye contact with him, just staring at the floor as if seeing the scene again. “What about you little guy, why is the warden’s panties all in a bunch over a little white dude” he asked, finally looking up.



Lucas sighed and told Polar Bear the story, when he was done the big guy smiled and shook his head, “boy you stepped in it something good bro” he said, Lucas nodded, he knew it too. He could see the big man playing with the thing the guard had given him in his hand. Now he was curious “what did the guard give you?” he asked, thinking it was a knife or something approximating it. Polar Bear held it up for Lucas to see, it was a small metal box with a few buttons on it, He leaned in to get a better look at it , but still couldn’t make heads of tails of the thing “What the hell is it?” Lucas asked Polar Bear looked it over and then motioned Lucas to watch the camera in the corner of the room. As Lucas looked at it the light on the bottom of the unit went out and then went back on again. He was impressed, that was something that could be very useful he thought. “They just gave that to you?” he asked surprised.  Polar Bear shrugged, yeah I was supposed to tune you up, this was to make sure the guard on duty didn’t see it” he said. Lucas thought about it, it might be a good idea and get them off his back if they thought that Polar Bear had, at the very least he needed a friend and someone who knew the politics of this bloc and Polar Bear could definitely fill that role.



After a few minutes of weighing the pros and cons Lucas sighed, I am really not going to enjoy this he thought standing up. “Hey man, I think it’s a good idea that you do tune me up, I mean don’t kill me, but give me a good once over for show, I don’t want to get you in trouble and might give me a little time before they try something else” Lucas said already regretting it.



A half an hour later, Lucas sat on his bunk while Polar Bear held out a cold towel to him “you could have hit a little less hard” he said glancing at the big man with his partially swollen eye, the other one having already swelled completely shut. Polar bear smiled sheepishly at him “had to make it believable” he answered shrugging. Well , that was true Lucas thought but he had a sneaking suspicion that Polar Bear rather enjoyed it. Once they were done he ensured that the big man turned the camera back on, they found a place to hide the little device, Lucas thought it would come in very handy later.

The next morning the doors opened, Polar Bear motioned to Lucas to join him and they walked out of there cell overlooking the central area. “We do chow then we get two hours in the common area before going back to our cells, we don’t get any yard time, this place is the only thing you will see here” he stated spreading his arms to show off the entirety of Downtown. Lucas glanced quickly over the area but was more interested in the other con’s coming out of there cell.



Most paid him very little notice, but there were two on the far side who seemed a little bit too interested in him. Lucas eyed the two Hispanic males, each of them shooting glances his way, they are definitely not subtle he thought “Hey Polar Bear, what’s the chance the guards might have put the word out on me” he asked the big guy and motioned across the room. Polar Bear took one look at the pair and winced. “Oh its possible , but if he gave it to those two, it’s not about getting you beat up, it’s about killing you” he said “Those are a couple of drug cartel goons who were caught this side of the border with a few bodies and a large amount of crank” he said still looking at the pair milling around their cell.



Lucas thought on it, that didn’t make sense, if they had Polar Bear set up to kick the shit out of him as a welcome to your new home, then why have him killed, no this is something else he thought still eyeing the two. He would have to keep a good eye on his back for a while until he figured it out.



The two made their way to the adjoining mess hall which was only a twelve-foot hallway between the common area and the mess hall, the place was setup to ensure no one was alone for any length of time. Walking into the mess hall Lucas recognized the same setup as the one he had spent the last three years at, he immediately got in line in front of his Roomie and walked down the length of unappetizing food laid out before them.



After getting his plate Polar Bear guided them over to a table with two other Black Males sitting at it, nodding at them Polar Bear pointed out each. “This is One Time” he said pointing out the lanky older man with greying hair, who nodded at Lucas and smiled “good to meet you fresh meat” and then Polar Bear pointed out the other one at the table, a young overweight man who was just north of twenty from the look of it “And this is Re Run” Re Run smiled showing off a mouth full of gold and nodded at Lucas “What’s up turkey, I see you got a nice warm welcome from the guards” he said, only loud enough that those at the table could hear. Lucas nodded and eyed Polar Bear 
“Yeah, they are big fans” he said, causing the two to laugh.



They ate in silence for a bit, Lucas keeping an eye out for the two Latino’s from earlier, but so far they had not come into the mess hall. Re Run leaned in getting Polar Bear’s attention “you hear the word” he whispered getting a confused look from his big friend. Lucas leaned a bit in, not wanting to intrude but definitely interested in the conversation. “Word is white boy over there has two bricks up to get his ticket punched” he said nodding towards Lucas. “What the hell does that mean?” Lucas asked Polar Bear who had suddenly developed a very worried expression. “It means someone is offering twenty grams of crank for your death” he said, Lucas sat back heavily in his chair, that would explain the look he had gotten from the Latino’s and suddenly looking around the room he could see more and more people eyeing him as he sat there, and a chill ran up his back. He was a dead man, “How the hell do I get out of it?” he whispered to Polar Bear a feeling he had not had in a while started to develop in the pit of his stomach, helplessness.



“Don’t worry I got your back” Polar Bear said, Lucas was incredibly touched, he had barely known the large man, and he had kicked his ass earlier, but now when he found himself in need, his cell mate and now friend was stepping up. “Polar man, you don’t owe this fool nothing” One Time hissed at his friend. Lucas didn’t begrudge him the attitude, he was right, they didn’t know each other well. Polar turned to his friend and shook his head. “This fool could have killed me this morning but didn’t, I don’t owe him, but honorable mother fuckers are a dying breed in this place, plus I get to give the big fuck you to the warden, oh I am in” he said shutting his friend down.



They finished there meal in silence , Lucas more interested in eyeing the other con’s then actually eating , turns out a threat to your life ruins your appetite he thought with a touch of dark humor.



Walking back to the common area , Polar Bear walked in front of him, his head on a swivel. Lucas knew if anything went down, he would push the big man out of the way, he didn’t want him to get hurt over something that was his fault. He had not known him for long, but Lucas felt like the two of them were going to be good friends. Well as long as they both lived out the day anyway.



He walked over to the weight room and Polar Bear took up a position outside the door, while Lucas went to work trying to bring his body back to where he had been prior to the trip to isolation.

All the while he watched through the glass partition to the con’s milling about the central area, no one was taking a lot of attention to him, but he could see the glances, and then he noticed the two Latino’s from earlier, they were standing at the bottom of the stairs, looking his way and talking. He didn’t like the look they were giving and liked it even less when they began walking over to the weight area.



“Shit” Lucas mumbled, realizing this might come to a head a lot sooner then he anticipated. He quickly walked to the door and as he did the two Latinos spread out, they would intercept him should he try to run, but that wasn’t what he had in mind. Leaning out he touched Polar Bear on the shoulder “Hey, go grab that device” he whispered to him, hoping he would go without noticing the two predator’s approaching. He had been looking down at a magazine and hadn’t caught the Latino’s stalking slowly towards the weight room. Lucas scanned the common area and noticed there were no drones and a suspicious absence of guards. Polar nodded , nose still in the magazine and walked towards the stairs. Thankfully not the ones the two assailants were coming from.



Lucas ducked back into the room and began to scan the items in here, the room had free weights and bars, but they were heavy, neither item would make a good weapon until the two were disabled and he could imagine they were not coming in here unarmed. So he would have to take them out hand to hand.



He began to slow his breathing and steadying his body, Lucas stepped further into the weight room putting him just about in the center as he watched the two Latino’s smiled, both now coming at the door and doing so quickly. It took only a moment before they entered, thankfully one stood by the door in case Lucas tried to run, leaving him only one person to deal with at a time. Not a smart move on their parts, but he would take it.



The first of the two moved into the room, his hand hidden behind his back as he stepped sideways, trying to circle Lucas . putting his friend at the door almost behind him. Dammit he hadn’t anticipated that, so now he would have to watch his back at the same time. Lucas thought. Knowing as soon as it looked like his friend was in trouble the one at the door would get involved. I am going to have to do this fast he thought again, maintaining eye contact with his closest attacker and waiting. His muscles were relaxed and knees were bent, but Lucas was ready to spring and no sooner had he settled into the stance that he was sprung upon, but not by the attacker at his front, but instead he had miscalculated, the one at the door was the instigator, his partner had maneuvered Lucas so that most of his back was facing the door. He cursed as he only had an instant to act.



He felt a hand on his shoulder as the assailants other hand came from behind his back, but before he could thrust the object into Lucas, he viciously slammed his head back, catching him square in the nose, as he did the attacker in the front launched himself forward something glinted in his hand as he slashed with it, catching Lucas on the arm and cutting his shirt and skin, Lucas rocketed out his leg catching him directly in the balls, the with a combo that would have made Sugar Ray Leonard proud, he quickly delivered a series of body blows and followed up with a chop to his Adams apple.



As soon as he did, he felt a sharp pain in the left side of his lower back. Yelling in pain he lifted his foot and drove it back, catching his attacker in the kneecap and driving down, he heard the satisfying crunch as the knee gave way and his attacker went down screaming onto the floor. Turning back he grabbed the first attackers arm, twisting it he brought his elbow down hard hearing the arm break.



Lucas walked out of the weight room to a set of pale surprised faces looking at him. Polar Bear lumbered quickly over “Jesus man, are you okay” Lucas followed his eyes and tried to figure out when he had put on a red shirt, right before the loss of blood caused him to collapse.



He awoke a few hours later laying in a hospital bed. The lights were dimmed but he could still see, one of the aggravating things about prison were, no clocks, he had no idea how long he had been out. Surveying the room, he could see both of his attackers laid up in beds further down. He smiled, at least he had given as good as he got Lucas thought, settling his head back onto the pillow.



Two days later the guards returned him to Downtown, no words exchanged, and no charges filed. He was surprised but figured the Warden wasn’t done with him yet and calling attention to him being attacked might make someone take notice he thought. Walking over to a smiling Pola Bear and One Time as they sat in the common area , both watching whatever program was on the holo viewer.



Lucas surveyed the room and he could see the clicks of inmates gathered around various spots, but also a lot were eyeing him, not with hostility, but Lucas thought it might have been something akin to gruding respect.



They returned to their cell when exercise time was over and the guards cleared out the common area, he walked Polar Bear through what had happened in the weight room. The big guy’s face fell “I could have helped man” he said almost like a five-year-old who was told he couldn’t have any more cookies. Lucas sighed “I know man, but I didn’t want you to get hurt” he said to him clapping him on the shoulder.



Lucas spent the next two weeks reading any book he could get ahold of from Bayard Holmes Spy craft essentials to A Spy’s guide to strategy by John Braddock. He still had Dyson’s reading list burned into his head and he was determined to finish it, though he couldn’t figure out why these were important. When he wasn’t reading, he was in the weights area, trying to build his body back to pre-solitary conditions. The stint in the void had really damaged his muscles and if he admitted it to himself, his psyche as well.



He had just finished a rather rigorous lifting set when the doors opened into the common area and the two Latino’s came limping back into Downtown with guards in tow. Lucas came out to watch them both of them shooting murderous looks his way but saying nothing as the guards escorted them to their cell and closed the door. One Time came over and leaned on the wall next to him “Those guys aren’t the forgiving type, I would watch your back man” he whispered and then headed towards the couches to catch up on some show or another that was on.



Lucas knew those guys were bad news and he should have ended them when he had the chance, He had a feeling that decision would come back and bite him in the ass. He returned to his cell , heading off any questions from a very worried Polar Bear who was set up in his bunk reading one of Lucas’s books. He had decided he would share his reading list with his friend and also teach the big man how to play chess.



He was horrible at it, but since there wasn’t much else to do to pass the time , Lucas was a patient teacher. Around about the tenth time Polar Bear asked Lucas to “King” him he had given up for the day. The big guy picked up one of the books and then with a curious look turned to his cell man “Man why did this old guy have you reading this stuff anyway” he asked, the obvious question that Lucas still didn’t have the answer to . He collected his thoughts for a moment before answering “Dyson is a private person, I am not sure why he had me reading, and aside from a good time waster, I never asked him. It seemed anytime I tried to get an answer whatever he said would eventually just lead to more questions” Lucas finished, shaking his head and realizing he missed the salty old man.



He returned to his own bunk and picked up the latest novel on his list paging open the old book. Ironically enough , because of the need for safety inmates were not allowed electronic devices so this place was one of the few where one could actually get printed material in this day and age.



The rest of the week went by fast both he and Polar Bear playing chess or reading and when in the common area, he had invited Polar Bear to join him, it was always better to lift with a partner anyway he justified to himself.



About halfway through his set an older man with a head full of white hair stopped in. Lucas was surprised, he had never seen him and with a head of hair like that he would have noticed. At first he thought someone new had come into downtown, but the inmate walked in, checking over his shoulder and then eying Polar Bear who had stepped forward to stand in-between Lucas and the new arrival.



“Can I help you” Lucas asked in a friendly tone, peaking around the mountain of a body guard. For a moment he said nothing, only staring at Polar Bear with a mix of suspicion and fear. Finally shaking his head he spoke “Can we talk alone, I have a message from Dyson” Lucas perked up, and clapped Polar Bear on the shoulder, his friend shot him a glance and Lucas nodded, Polar Bear went and took a seat on the weight bench, but well within listening distance. The old man looked at him and then back at Lucas “he is fine, I trust him” he said , getting a nod from the new comer. “Dyson wanted to ensure you were okay, and if you needed anything” he asked repeating what was told to him. Lucas thought about it, he could be an ass, but Dyson wasn’t all powerful, he couldn’t have known what the warden would do , or have the ability to stop it. Lucas thought about it and then realized in fact he did have a request. “I need another list of books, also anything he can tell me about what the warden has planned for me would be great, I have already survived two attacks, I would love it if he had a heads up before there are any more” Lucas finished. The old man just nodded and left.



“How the hell does he get to move around?” Lucas wondered out loud, Polar Bear came to stand next to him. “He is an old timer, they have various jobs, cleaning , running files , things like that, but it allows them to access to most of the prison secured areas” he said as if everyone should know this.



Lucas nodded, at least he had a communication line with Dyson again, he was getting worried about the old guy.
